items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to tell the Israelites that they had seen Him speak to them from heaven. Passes 1 and 2 agree on this quote; they differ only in punctuation and capital letters. The document itself only gives the verse number 20:22. Naming it as Exodus 20:22 (King James Version) is model-prior, not something the evidence states.
items.action: said unto / talked with from heaven
items.place: heaven (as stated in the text); no earthly location given in the document
